name: plaiiin-workflow
description: Work with plaiiin Workflow from Claude: tickets, their states and the views over them, kept as files in a git repository. `workflow-app` drives the Workflow app on this Mac over its local MCP — read, create, move and comment on tickets in a repository you have checked out. `workflow-server` drives a Workflow server over its REST API with an API key — the same tickets from anywhere, no checkout needed. Both write changes the workspace's history can explain.
